target: acceptance 3 — the assumed output size scales with effort; ultra runs parallel subagents so a flat number would understate the costliest path
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort standard 2>es >/dev/null; cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort ultra 2>eu >/dev/null; S=$(grep -o 'assumed output [0-9]*' es | grep -o '[0-9]*'); U=$(grep -o 'assumed output [0-9]*' eu | grep -o '[0-9]*'); echo "S=$S U=$U"; [ -n "$S" ] && [ -n "$U" ] && [ "$U" -gt "$S" ] && echo ULTRA_ASSUMES_MORE
